scenes.heading: Why these projects fail
scenes.narration: Every document to video project fails the same way. You build the slides first, then try to make the narration fit them. Timing drift is unfixable, and every edit re-breaks it.

scenes.heading: Invert it
scenes.narration: So invert it. Narration becomes the master clock. The renderer is told how long it has, and fits its animation into whatever it is given. Sync stops being a problem you solve and becomes one you never have.

scenes.heading: The pipeline
scenes.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A["doc.md"] --> B["Script"]
    B --> C["Narrate"]
    C --> D["Render"]
    D --> E["video.mp4"]
scenes.narration: Five stages. The document becomes a script, the script becomes audio, and only then does anything get drawn. Rendering is last because it is the only stage that needs to know how long each scene runs.
